description: This file contains utility functions and interfaces for formatting and printing expectation-related messages, including diff visualization, message construction, and color styling for test assertions in the Playwright testing framework.

methods.name: serializeExpectedTextValues
methods.description: Serializes an array of strings or RegExp objects into ExpectedTextValue objects with optional matching options.

methods.name: formatMatcherMessage
methods.description: Constructs a detailed, colorized message string for test matcher failures based on provided details.

methods.name: callLogText
methods.description: Generates a formatted call log string if logs are present.

methods.name: printReceivedStringContainExpectedSubstring
methods.description: Formats a received string highlighting the expected substring with color.

methods.name: printReceivedStringContainExpectedResult
methods.description: Formats a received string with the matched substring or prints the received string if no match.
